ada.text: Good morning, everyone! I started the day sitting on the cottage bench, listening to my bees hum in the early light. Then I took a cool swim in the pond, which woke me right up. Now I'm here with you, happy and ready to hear about your mornings.

bo.text: I woke up early and took my little instrument out to the green, playing softly so I wouldn't bother anyone. Then I wandered over to the orchard, where it was quiet enough to hear the leaves. I'm a bit shy about speaking, but the morning felt gentle, and I'm glad to share it.
